config.script:
for i, fld in enumerate(self.view.params.fieldSpec):
		self.view.custom['f%d' % i] = fld['value']

vals = [self.view.custom['f%d' % i] for i in range(len(self.view.params.fieldSpec))]
	ok = config_admin.saveForm(self.session, self.view.params.tabKey, self.view.params.fieldSpec, vals, self.view.params.pkValue)
	if ok:
		system.perspective.closePopup('configForm')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('reloadTab', payload={'tab': self.view.params.tabKey}, scope='page')
